name: Sign Out
summary: An authenticated user explicitly ends the current client session and returns to an anonymous authentication state.
finalOutcome: The current client session is terminated, local authentication state is cleared, protected application state is no longer available through that session, and the client returns to the Welcome surface.

sourceReferences.note: Existing cookie-backed logoff terminates the current ASP.NET Identity sign-in session and records UserLogout.
RevokeRefreshTokenAsync provides current-device refresh-token revocation for token-backed clients.
Mobile currently clears local auth state but does not yet invoke server-side current-token revocation.

The category is presented as Sign Out while retaining the stable session-management category key. Sign Out is modeled as one atomic action from authenticated host UI to auth.welcome; no confirmation or completion AuthView is required.
